key_insight: CP-Agent uses a harness-engineered LLM agent to autonomously plan and execute complete crystal plasticity workflows from natural-language instructions while keeping decisions interpretable through visible reasoning traces.
engineering_relevance: It can reduce the manual burden of calibration, benchmarking, and multi-step simulation setup for polycrystalline metal constitutive modeling, enabling faster and more systematic parameter studies.
method: ReAct-style agent for reasoning over tool choice and execution order
Typed tool schemas, dispatcher, and safety-bounded iteration loop form the harness
Numerical search is delegated to established optimizers rather than the LLM
evidence_signal: The agent was evaluated on four case studies, including stainless steel 316L calibration, copper benchmark validation and texture recovery, and Mg-Zn-Ca multi-pass rolling texture evolution, with correct workflow sequencing and physically interpretable results across repeated runs.
watch_item: Performance depends on well-designed tool interfaces and bounded execution, so robustness may drop if the workflow tools, schemas, or domain assumptions are incomplete or poorly specified.
paper_title: CP-Agent: A Harness-Engineered Agent for Crystal Plasticity Simulation Workflows
